description.value: Shawnigan House Coffee + Chocolate has been serving the Shawnigan Lake community since 2000, offering globally sourced coffee alongside house-made artisan chocolates crafted with Belgian and organic ingredients. Located on the Shawnigan Lake-Mill Bay Road, it is a natural stop for cyclists riding the Vancouver Crossing Loop through the Cowichan Valley. The shop sells individual truffles and chocolate bars as well as a full espresso menu, making it an easy place to refuel with something sweet.

address.value: 1761 Shawnigan Lake-Mill Bay Rd, Shawnigan Lake, BC V0R 2W2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active coffee-and-artisan-chocolate shop at 1761 Shawnigan Lake-Mill Bay Rd, Shawnigan Lake, BC, with phone (250) 733-2245 matching across all subpages. The menu page explicitly labels numerous items as Gluten free, Vegetarian, and Vegan, providing positive evidence for that amenity. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific infrastructure, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name uses a plus sign ('Coffee + Chocolate') while the website consistently uses 'and' ('Coffee and Chocolate'); minor stylistic discrepancy.
Menu subpage title reads 'Shawnigan Cafe' rather than the full business name — possible outdated page title.
Community is listed as 'Duncan' in OSM but the business address is Shawnigan Lake; these are distinct communities roughly 15 km apart.
